title: PaMuk-Bench: A Parallel Multilingual Multitask Benchmark for Vision-Language Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.27521v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While vision-language models (VLMs) currently obtain notable results for highly-studied languages, e.g. English, they exhibit significant performance drops in certain low-resource languages, especially due to the lack of annotated datasets. To this end, we propose PaMuk-Bench, a novel parallel multilingual multitask benchmark for vision-language tasks. Our benchmark includes a set of over 10K curated English prompts that are translated into six languages: Arabic, Danish, French, Hindi, Italian, Romanian. Parallel translations, which are obtained via a semi-automatic process, along with accompanying generated and retrieved images enable the comparative development and evaluation of VLMs across a wide range of tasks: text-to-image generation, image captioning, content-based image retrieval, image generation difficulty estimation, image retrieval difficulty estimation. translated_title: PaMuk-Bench：一个面向视觉-语言任务的平行多语言多任务基准
translated_abstract: 尽管视觉-语言模型（VLM）目前在英语等被广泛研究的语言上取得了显著成果，但由于缺乏标注数据集，它们在某些低资源语言上表现出显著的性能下降。为此，我们提出了PaMuk-Bench，一个新颖的面向视觉-语言任务的平行多语言多任务基准。我们的基准包含一组超过10K条精选的英文提示，这些提示被翻译成六种语言：阿拉伯语、丹麦语、法语、印地语、意大利语、罗马尼亚语。通过半自动过程获得的平行翻译，以及配套的生成和检索图像，使得能够在广泛的任务上对VLM进行对比性开发和评估，这些任务包括：文本到图像生成、图像描述生成、基于内容的图像检索、图像生成难度估计、图像检索难度估计。我们通过实验证明，零样本英语和多语言预训练……
tldr: 本文提出了PaMuk-Bench，一个包含超过10K条平行翻译提示（涵盖阿拉伯语、丹麦语、法语、印地语、意大利语和罗马尼亚语六种语言）的多语言多任务视觉-语言基准，用于系统评估视觉-语言模型在低资源语言上跨多种任务的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PaMuk-Bench, a novel parallel multilingual multitask benchmark with over 10K curated English prompts translated into six languages, enabling comparative evaluation of vision-language models across low-resource languages and diverse tasks such as text-to-image generation, image captioning, and content-based image retrieval.
